statement: The survivor is Morgan Hale, a 25-year-old male Evacuee (Survivor profession) in the new world Rangely, with identity confirmed in play
The game starts inside government evac shelter A-23 on Spring day 61 at 8:00 AM, in a dim hall with benches and lockers
The NPC Harland 'Have-Not' Beebe is in the shelter, refused to travel with the survivor and left saying 'See ya'
The shelter's east door opens to an open grass field with a small forest and pond to the north-west
A loose stick lay in the field outside the shelter; the survivor picked it up and wields it
The smartphone has a flashlight app (battery 53/56) that gives light in dark areas
The shelter basement holds protein rations in wrappers, a FEMA evacuation pamphlet and more loose items; reached by stairs from the main hall
The shelter's east-side lockers held sealed water bottles, more protein rations, a flashlight, an emergency jacket and blanket and a tupperware, all picked up
Moving over benches in the shelter is slow
Crafting is impossible in the dark; the shelter hall is very dark except by a window or light source
A wooden club takes 5 minutes, needs one plank and a cutting tool, and the survivor knows the recipe at fabrication 1 with about 21% minor failure chance
Opening the curtained window on the shelter's north wall gives bright light there, a workable place to craft
A wooden club was crafted from memory and is on the ground at the north window; the stick is still wielded
The survivor carries 5 sealed bottles with 2 units of clean water each and 10 protein rations
The plan is to find renewable water and food and equipment for indefinite survival, continuing cautiously without save or debug

note: Deactivated the flashlight app after using it in the basement
Wooden club recipe showed too dark to craft
Opened the north window curtains to get light before crafting
Crafted the wooden club from memory
